# COR082 `missing-action-specifier`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

An `open` statement has no `action=` specifier.

## Why

Without `action=` the file is opened with a processor-dependent action, usually read-write: an
input file can be modified by mistake, and opening a read-only file may fail. State the intent
with `action='read'`, `'write'` or `'readwrite'`.

## Reported

```fortran
open(newunit=u, file='mesh.dat')
```

## Preferred

```fortran
open(newunit=u, file='mesh.dat', action='read')
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR082] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR082` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C043` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
